scripts.dev: pnpm --filter shared build && concurrently "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter shared test && pnpm --filter api test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter frontend test:e2e
